blocks.text: A parameter keeps a data value separate from the SQL command text. It avoids building the command by joining input strings.
Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.

items: `sp_executesql` accepts SQL text, parameter definitions and parameter values as separate inputs.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: The parameter value 4 produces next_number equal to 5.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not join untrusted text into dynamic SQL. Parameters represent values, not arbitrary table names.
